---
name: PS5 bug report
about: A crash, glitch or performance problem in the PS5 build
title: "[PS5] "
labels: bug, ps5
---

**Build:** (e.g. v0.1.0-alpha)
**Firmware:** (e.g. 13.60)

**What happened**

**What you were doing** (chapter, menu, move...)

**Settings:** defaults / or which ones you changed (resolution, render target
path, frame pacing, input latency...)

**Logs:** zip the `PPSA94202/logs/` folder and attach it. The newest
`ng2_NNN.log` matters most - if it ends with
`Call to invalid or unregistered function at guest address 0x...`, put that
address here too.

Please do not attach or link any game files.
